beliefs.label: Safest Solve
beliefs.statement: I am safest when I solve the practical problem in front of me

receipts.quote: A bus stalled on Powell, and I stayed after shift tracing the loose ground wire. I forgot Mara had saved dinner.
My sister called crying about her landlord, so I opened rental listings before asking what she wanted. Finding options calmed me.

beliefs.label: Love Easier
beliefs.statement: Love is easier to trust when it is said out loud

receipts.quote: Before leaving for work, I told Mara I was glad she had handled the roofer. She smiled and asked me to say things like that more often.
At Sunday supper, I told my sister I missed seeing her instead of only asking about bills. She called me the next night.

beliefs.label: Need Name
beliefs.statement: I need to name disappointment before it turns into distance

receipts.quote: When Mara canceled our coast weekend for archive work, I said I was disappointed before opening the calendar. We picked another Saturday together.
My friend missed my birthday dinner without calling. The next day I told him it had stung instead of acting normal.

beliefs.label: Day's Work
beliefs.statement: A day's work should leave something in the tank for home

receipts.quote: The depot offered overtime Saturday, but I left at four to meet Mara at the nursery. We brought home a cedar.
I traded a late shift so I could cook when Mara's mother visited. The sauce burned a little, but I was there.

beliefs.label: Would Rather
beliefs.statement: I would rather ask a clumsy question than guess what someone means

receipts.quote: Mara went quiet after I mentioned my brother's loan. I asked whether she was worried about the amount or the timing.
A coworker said the new schedule was interesting. I asked if that meant useful or impossible.

beliefs.label: Take Changed
beliefs.statement: I can take a changed plan seriously without making it personal

receipts.quote: The mechanic course moved online with two days notice. I booked a library room and made it work.
Our landlord rescheduled the inspection during my shift. I called Mara, then asked a neighbor to let them in.

beliefs.label: Shared Money
beliefs.statement: Shared money needs a shared conversation before it becomes urgent

receipts.quote: When my brother asked for rent money, I told him Mara and I would talk before saying yes. We looked at our budget that night.
Mara wanted a bigger rug, so we measured the room and our savings before ordering. Neither of us had to persuade the other.

beliefs.label: Machine Tells
beliefs.statement: A machine tells the truth when you listen to its small sounds

receipts.quote: A bus made a faint clicking sound only on left turns. I listened near the rear axle until the worn bracket showed itself.
Before replacing a compressor, I heard the hiss that told me the line was leaking. The pressure gauge agreed later.

shared_items.label: How I mean things
shared_items.statement: I start with the practical fact, then find the feeling underneath.

shared_items.label: What feels like care
shared_items.statement: A clear check-in means more to me than being silently rescued.

shared_items.label: How to bring something up with me
shared_items.statement: Say what changed for you without making me guess the charge.
